blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Global building and settlement datasets increasingly support population mapping, exposure assessment, urban monitoring, and other analyses of the built environment, yet comparative evidence remains fragmented across products, geographic regions, reference datasets, spatial scales, and evaluation methods. We benchmark seven global or near-global products, including Overture Maps, Global Building Atlas, 3D-GloBFP, Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (OBT), Microsoft TEMPO, GHSL, and WSF Tracker, against harmonized reference footprints across 135 study areas. The evaluation combines complementary measures of detection, geometric agreement, and aggregate quantity accuracy, together with stratified analyses of settlement characteristics and diagnostic experiments on error size and temporal alignment. Overture achieved the highest median city-level vector F1 (0.786). Raster rankings were resolution-dependent: OBT achieved the highest median F1 at 10m (0.642), whereas WSF Tracker led at 100m (0.862). However, WSF Tracker substantially overestimated built-up area, emphasizing that when using raster products, it is important for the user to understand whether the raster identifies only buildings or includes additional impervious surfaces. Raster accuracy increased consistently with building density (Spearman ρ = 0.58 \rho=0.58 – 0.75 0.75 ), while small candidate buildings were disproportionately associated with false positives in the vector products. Temporally aligning WSF Tracker with reference imagery increased mean F1 by 0.060 (median +0.037), indicating that the reported accuracies are conservative in rapidly growing areas. The study establishes a reproducible benchmark for comparing heterogeneous global urban and settlement layer datasets across geographic and settlement contexts. Keywords: Global building datasets; settlement layers; building footprints; benchmarking; accuracy assessment
blocks.zh: 全球建筑和住区数据集日益支持人口测绘、接触评估、城市监测以及对已建成环境的其他分析,但比较证据在产品、地理区域、参考数据集、空间尺度和评价方法方面仍然支离破碎。 我们参照135个研究领域的统一参考足迹,对7种全球或近全球产品,包括Overture Maps、Global Building Atlas、3D-GloBFP、Google Open Building 2.5D Timperal(OBT)、Microsoft TEMPO、GHSL和WSF Tracker进行基准衡量。 评价结合了检测、几何协议和总量准确性等补充措施,同时对结算特征进行了分层分析,并就误差大小和时间吻合进行了诊断实验。 overture实现了城市一级最高中位矢量F1(0.786). 拉斯特的排名依赖分辨率:OBT在10米(0.642)时达到了F1最高中位数,而WSF Tracker则领先100米(0.862). 然而,无国界医生组织 跟踪器大大高估了建成区,强调在使用光栅产品时,用户必须了解光栅是只识别建筑物,还是包含额外的不透水面. raster精度随着建筑密度的提高而不断提高(Spearman $ = 0.58\rho = 0.58– 0.75 0.75),而小候选建筑则不成比例地与矢量产物中的假阳性有关. 暂时使WSF跟踪仪与参考图像一致,平均F1增加了0.060(中位数+0.037),表明报告的速率在快速增长地区是保守的. 该研究确定了可复制的基准,用于比较不同地理和住区的全球城市和住区层数据集。 关键词 : 全球建筑数据集;定居点层;建筑足迹;基准;准确性评估

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatially explicit information on buildings and settlements is fundamental to the analysis of the built environment and supports a growing range of applications. In population mapping, building footprints serve as important covariates for disaggregating census or survey counts to fine spatial units, both in top-down dasymetric frameworks [ 1 ] and in bottom-up estimation from household surveys where recent census data are unavailable [ 2 ] . In multi-hazard risk analysis, building counts and built-up area are core inputs to exposure models [ 3 , 4 ] . Settlement layers derived from Earth observation are also used to monitor urban growth and compute internationally reported urbanisation indicators [ 5 ] . At finer spatial scales, building geometry can reveal settlement morphology, street access, infrastructure deficits, and patterns of urban informality [ 6 ] . These applications are particularly important in low- and middle-income countries, where frequently updated local information often remains limited despite rapid settlement growth and increasing demand for housing, public services, and climate-resilient development [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 关于建筑物和住区的空间明确信息对分析建筑环境至关重要,支持越来越多的应用。 在人口测绘中,建筑足迹是将普查或调查计数分解为细小空间单位的重要共变物,无论是在自上而下的差异度框架[1]中,还是在没有最新普查数据的家庭调查中从下而上的估计[2]。 在多种危害风险分析中,建筑物清点和建筑区是接触模型的核心投入[3,4]。 来自地球观测的定居层也被用于监测城市生长和计算国际报告的城市化指标[5]。 在更细的空间尺度上,建筑几何可以揭示定居点形态,街道出入,基础设施不足,以及城市非正规性的模式[6]. 这些应用在中低收入国家尤其重要,这些国家经常更新的地方信息往往仍然有限,尽管定居点迅速增长,对住房、公共服务和气候抗御能力发展的需求不断增加[7]。

blocks.en: Advances in Earth observation, machine learning, volunteered geographic information, and large-scale geospatial processing have produced several global or near-global building and settlement products. These datasets substantially expand the availability of built-environment information in places where authoritative cadastral or municipal data are unavailable. However, they differ in input imagery, observation period, spatial resolution, geographic coverage, update frequency, post-processing, and data structure. Vector products represent individual building polygons, sometimes with additional attributes such as height or confidence, whereas raster products represent building presence, built-up area, density, height, or broader settlement extent within grid cells. Products designed to represent individual structures and those designed to characterize settlement extent therefore encode different aspects of the built environment and cannot be evaluated or interpreted using identical criteria.
blocks.zh: 地球观测、机器学习、自愿地理信息和大规模地理空间处理方面的进展,产生了若干全球或近全球建筑和定居点产品。 这些数据集大大增加了在缺乏权威地籍或市政数据的地方提供建筑环境信息的机会。 然而,在输入图像、观测期、空间分辨率、地理覆盖范围、更新频率、处理后和数据结构方面,它们各不相同。 矢量产物代表单个建筑多边形,有时具有高度或置信度等额外属性,而光栅产物则代表建筑存在,建成面积,密度,高度,或网格细胞内更广泛的定居范围. 因此,旨在代表个别结构的产品和旨在说明定居范围的产品将建筑环境的不同方面编码,不能使用相同的标准进行评价或解释。

blocks.en: These representational differences have direct consequences for how product accuracy should be understood. Omission of buildings reduces completeness and may bias estimated building counts or built-up area, whereas false detections can inflate both. Positional and delineation errors can produce poor geometric agreement even where a building has been detected, while a product can reproduce aggregate built-up area reasonably well without correctly detecting or locating individual structures. Conversely, strong spatial overlap does not necessarily imply accurate estimates of total building area or counts. These distinctions are especially consequential in informal, peri-urban, rural, and rapidly changing settlements, where buildings may be small, densely clustered, constructed from locally variable materials, or poorly represented in the imagery used to generate global products. Previous studies have consequently reported substantial disagreement among nominally similar global building datasets [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些表述差异对如何理解产品准确性有直接影响。 建筑物的缺失会降低完整性,并可能使估计的建筑数量或建筑面积出现偏差,而错误的检测则会加剧两者。 位置和划界错误即使发现建筑物,也会产生差的几何协议,而一种产品可以合理地复制集成区而不正确探测或定位个别结构。 相反,高度的空间重叠并不一定意味着准确估计总建筑面积或建筑数量。 这些区别在非正规、近郊、农村和迅速变化的住区尤为突出,这些住区的建筑物可能规模小、集聚密集、用当地可变材料建造,或者在用于生产全球产品的图像中代表性不足。 因此,以往的研究表明,名义上类似的全球建筑数据集存在重大分歧。

blocks.en: Which accuracy metric to report is therefore itself an evaluation-design decision with operational consequences. Accuracy-assessment guidelines have long emphasized that validation measures should reflect the intended use of a dataset [ 9 ] , and recent needs-based frameworks for building data reach a similar conclusion [ 10 ] . Different users may ask different questions: whether a product detects the buildings that exist, as required for exposure screening or service-gap analysis; whether mapped footprints reproduce building geometry, as required for morphology or parcel-scale analyses; whether aggregate building area and counts are reliable, as required for housing-stock or demand estimation; or whether systematic errors are sufficiently predictable to permit local calibration. No single metric captures all of these properties. An operational evaluation should therefore distinguish between complementary dimensions of accuracy rather than reduce product performance to a single headline score.
blocks.zh: 因此,哪一个精确度衡量标准本身就是具有业务后果的评价设计决定。 准确性评估准则长期以来一直强调,验证措施应反映数据集的预期用途[9],最近基于需要的建立数据框架得出类似结论[10]。 不同的用户可能会提出不同的问题:某一产品是否检测到现有的建筑物,这是接触筛选或服务差距分析所需要的;所绘制的足迹是否复制建筑物几何,这是形态分析或包裹规模分析所需要的;总建筑面积和计数是否可靠,这是住房存量或需求估计所需要的;或者系统错误是否足够可预测,可以进行局部校准。 没有单一的衡量标准可以捕捉所有这些属性. 因此,业务评价应区分准确性的补充层面,而不是将产品性能降低到单一标题分数。

blocks.en: A second requirement is understanding where global products systematically succeed or fail. Aggregate statistics can conceal substantial spatial and contextual variation. Audits of global building-footprint datasets have documented differences in performance associated with wealth, population density, urban–rural setting, and building size, with the magnitude and direction of these biases varying among products and countries [ 11 ] . Disaggregated reporting is likewise recognized as important for Earth-observation-derived indicators more broadly, particularly where aggregate measures can obscure performance in vulnerable or underrepresented settings [ 12 ] . Evaluation results may additionally depend on properties of the reference data themselves, including mapping practice, source provenance, geographic distribution, and temporal alignment with the product being assessed. This study therefore considers both overall accuracy and variation associated with building density, building size, reference-data source, and temporal mismatch.
blocks.zh: 第二项要求是了解全球产品系统成败之处。 综合统计可以掩盖空间和背景的巨大变化。 对全球建筑脚印数据集的审计记录了与财富、人口密度、城乡环境和建筑规模有关的绩效差异,这些偏差的程度和方向因产品和国家而异[11]。 同样,分类报告也被认为对更广泛的地球观测指标十分重要,特别是在总体衡量可能掩盖脆弱或代表性不足环境中的业绩的情况下[12]。 评价结果可能还取决于参考数据本身的特性,包括绘图做法、来源、地理分布以及时间与所评估产品的一致性。 因此,本研究既考虑到总体准确性,也考虑到与建筑密度、建筑规模、参考数据来源和时间不匹配有关的差异。

blocks.en: Against this background, the study addresses three questions: (1) which vector and raster products achieve the highest overall accuracy within their respective data structures? (2) How does performance vary with reference-data source, building density, building size, and raster evaluation resolution? And (3) how does detection accuracy relate to geometric and aggregate quantity accuracy?
blocks.zh: 在这一背景下,本研究涉及三个问题:(1)哪一种矢量和光栅产品在各自的数据结构中达到最高的总体准确度? (2)在参考数据来源,建筑密度,建筑规模,光栅评价分辨率方面,性能有何不同? (3) 探测精确度与几何和总量精确度有何关系?

blocks.en: To answer these questions, the study compares seven widely used global or near-global urban datasets. The vector products are Overture Maps Buildings, the Global Building Atlas (GBA), and 3D-GloBFP [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . The raster products are Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (OBT), Microsoft TEMPO, the Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL), and the World Settlement Footprint (WSF) Tracker [ 16 , 17 , 5 , 18 ] . Products are evaluated against harmonized reference footprints derived from Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team projects, World Bank-supported mapping activities, SpaceNet 7, and University of Edinburgh campaigns across 135 cities, communities, and municipalities. The evaluation combines complementary measures of detection, geometric agreement, and quantity accuracy and examines how these measures change across spatial scales and settlement conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这些问题,本研究比较了七个广泛使用的全球或近全球城市数据集. 矢量产品是Overture Maps Buildings,全球建筑图集(GBA)和3D-GloBFP[13,14,15]. 光栅产品有Google Open Building 2.5D Temperal(OBT),Microsoft TEMPO,全球人类住区层(GHSL),以及世界定居足迹追踪器[16,17,5,18]. 根据人道主义OpenStreetMap小组项目、世界银行支助的制图活动、SpaceNet 7和爱丁堡大学在135个城市、社区和城市开展的运动所产生的统一参考足迹,对产品进行评价。 评价结合了检测、几何协议和数量准确性等补充措施,并审查了这些措施如何在空间尺度和定居条件之间发生变化。

blocks.en: The study makes three contributions. First, it provides a harmonized multi-source benchmark for seven vector and raster products across 135 study areas with substantial coverage of the Global South. Second, it develops an evaluation framework in which complementary groups of metrics are explicitly linked to different operational questions and applied consistently within the corresponding data modalities. Third, it combines aggregate benchmarking with stratified and diagnostic analyses of building density, building size, reference-data source, and temporal alignment to identify the conditions under which individual products succeed or fail. Rather than seeking a universally superior building dataset, the analysis identifies which products perform well for particular representations, metrics, spatial scales, and settlement conditions.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有三项贡献。 首先,它为覆盖全球南部的135个研究地区的7个病媒和光栅产品提供了统一的多来源基准。 第二,它制定了一个评价框架,使各种补充指标明确与不同的业务问题挂钩,并在相应的数据模式中一致适用。 第三,综合基准与建筑密度、建筑面积、参考数据来源和时间一致性的分层和诊断分析相结合,以确定单个产品成败的条件。 该分析不是寻求一个普遍优越的建筑数据集,而是确定哪些产品对特定表述、尺度、空间尺度和定居条件表现良好。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Comparisons of global building-footprint and built-up-area products remain difficult because studies differ not only in the products and geographic regions considered, but also in their reference data, unit of analysis, spatial scale, and definition of accuracy. Vector-product evaluations commonly assess individual-building detection or polygon overlap, whereas raster-product evaluations more often measure pixel- or grid-level agreement, categorical accuracy, or correspondence in aggregated built-up area. Even when studies report similarly named metrics, results calculated at the level of individual buildings, pixels, grid cells, tiles, or cities are not necessarily comparable. The existing literature should therefore be interpreted in terms of the particular dimension of accuracy being evaluated rather than as a set of interchangeable scores.
blocks.zh: 全球建筑脚印和建成区产品的比较仍然很困难,因为研究不仅在所考虑的产品和地理区域方面,而且在参考数据、分析单位、空间尺度和准确性定义方面也有所不同。 病媒-产品评价通常评估单个建筑检测或多边形重叠,而光栅-产品评价则更经常地衡量像素或网格级别的协议、绝对的准确性,或汇总积聚区的对应性。 即使研究报告了类似命名的度量衡,在单个建筑,像素,网格细胞,瓷砖或城市等层次计算的结果也不一定具有可比性. 因此,应将现有文献解释为评价准确性的特定方面,而不是一套可互换的分数。

blocks.en: Among vector-product comparisons, Chamberlain et al. [8] evaluated Google Open Buildings, Ecopia, Microsoft Building Footprints, and OpenStreetMap (OSM) across Africa using pairwise Jaccard coefficients, building counts, and mapped area. Median Jaccard values commonly ranged from approximately 0.40 to 0.60, demonstrating substantial disagreement among nominally similar products. Because the analysis primarily measured inter-product agreement rather than accuracy against an independent reference, however, it could not determine which product was most accurate. Similarly, Okyere et al. [19] compared Google and Microsoft footprints with OSM across five cities and found substantial geographic variation in footprint overlap, with Microsoft–OSM mean IoU ranging from approximately 0.84 in Houston to 0.46 in Caracas. These results demonstrate spatial heterogeneity in geometric agreement, although interpretation is complicated by geographic variation in OSM completeness and positional quality.
blocks.zh: 在矢量产品比较中,Chamberlain等人。 [8] 评价了Google开放建筑、Ecopia、微软建筑脚印和OpenStreetMap(OSM), 中间的Jaccard值通常在0.40至0.60之间,表明名义上相似的产品之间有很大的分歧。 然而,由于分析主要衡量的是产品间协议,而不是对照独立参考的准确性,因此无法确定哪一种产品最准确。 同样, Okyere等人著. [19] 将Google和微软的足迹与OSM在五个城市的足迹进行比较,发现足迹重叠的地域差异很大,Microsoft–OSM指IoU从休斯顿的约0.84到加拉加斯的0.46. 这些结果表明几何协议中的空间异质性,尽管由于OSM完整性和位置质量的地理差异,解释更为复杂.

blocks.en: Producer-led evaluations provide more detailed measures of instance-detection performance but are generally based on product-specific reference samples and protocols. Sirko et al. [20] reported a mean average precision of 0.657 at an IoU threshold of 0.5 for the original Google Open Buildings model across Africa and South Asia. The Global Building Atlas evaluation compared GBA, Microsoft Building Footprints, 3D-GloBFP, and other datasets using AP 50 \mathrm{AP}_{50} and AR 50 \mathrm{AR}_{50} [ 14 ] . In Asia, reported AP 50 \mathrm{AP}_{50} values were 6.5 for Microsoft, 8.7 for 3D-GloBFP, and 27.9 for GBA. Although the study included 28 cities across five continents, Africa was excluded because suitable authoritative reference data were unavailable. Such evaluations establish the capabilities of individual extraction systems, but their instance-detection scores are not directly equivalent to geometric overlap, aggregate area agreement, or results obtained using different sampling and aggregation strategies.
blocks.zh: 由生产者主导的评价提供了更详细的实例检测绩效衡量标准,但一般以产品特定参考样本和协议为基础。 Sirko等 (英语). [20] 报告非洲和南亚各地最初的Google开放建筑模型在IoU阈值0.5时的平均精度为0.657。 Global Building Atlas评价比较了GBA,Microsoft Building Footprints,3D-GloBFP,以及其他使用AP 50\mathrm{AP}_{50}和AR 50\mathrm{AR}_{50}[14]的数据集. 在亚洲,AP 50\mathrm{AP}_{50}的数值是微软的6.5,3D-GloBFP的8.7和GBA的27.9. 虽然这项研究包括五大洲的28个城市,但非洲被排除在外,因为没有适当的权威参考数据。 这种评价确定了个别采掘系统的能力,但其实例检测分数并不直接等同于几何重叠、总面积协议或使用不同取样和汇总战略获得的结果。

blocks.en: Raster settlement products have largely been evaluated through separate validation traditions. WSF2015 was assessed using approximately 900,000 reference samples across 50 global tiles and achieved an average Kappa coefficient of 0.6885 [ 21 ] . For GHSL R2023, Pesaresi et al. [5] reported an IoU of approximately 0.92 for binary built-up classification at 10 m. Earlier validation across 20 Chinese cities reported an R 2 R^{2} of 0.82 after aggregation to 1 km cells and identified density-dependent bias, with built-up area underestimated in sparse locations and overestimated in dense areas [ 22 ] . These examples illustrate an important distinction: classification agreement at the native or near-native grid scale and agreement in aggregated built-up quantities measure different properties of a settlement product. Raster validation is also sensitive to evaluation resolution because aggregation can absorb small positional and delineation errors that are penalized at finer spatial scales.
blocks.zh: 拉斯特结算产品基本上通过单独的验证传统进行评估. 利用全球50块瓷砖的大约90万个参考样本对WPF2015进行了评估,并实现了平均卡帕系数0.6885 [21]. GHSL R2023, Pesaresi等人著。 [5] 报告在10米处进行二进制积分分类的IoU约为0.92. 中国20个城市早先的验证报告,在集合到1千米的细胞后,R 2 RQQX2}0.82,并查明了密度依赖偏差,在稀疏地区,积聚面积被低估,在密集地区被高估[22]. 这些例子说明了一个重要的区别:本地或近本地网格尺度的分类协议和累积数量总量中的协议衡量定居产品的不同特性。 Raster验证对评价分辨率也具有敏感性,因为聚合可以吸收较小的位置和划界错误,这些错误在更细的空间尺度上受到处罚。

blocks.en: Recent studies have expanded both the range of datasets evaluated and the quality dimensions considered. Gabrielli et al. [23] compared six European building datasets, including OSM, Microsoft, Overture, and EUBUCCO, with a primary focus on semantic-attribute availability and completeness. The OECD Geospatial Lab proposed a broader evaluation framework covering data quality, usability, and governance, while its quantitative analyses emphasized building counts and areas rather than object-level precision and recall [ 10 ] . A recent preprint compared GHSL, Microsoft TEMPO, GBA, and Overture with manually labelled ORBITaL-Net data across multiple raster grids and stratified results by region, settlement density, and national income group [ 24 ] . The study found that either GBA or TEMPO generally achieved the highest overall accuracy depending on the evaluation criterion, while performance was substantially lower in Africa and Asia and declined for several products in high-density urban areas. Its primary objective, however, was gridded building-area estimation rather than a joint assessment of individual-building detection, matched-footprint geometry, and aggregate quantity agreement.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究扩大了所评价的数据集的范围和所考虑的质量方面。 加布里埃尔利等人. [23] 比较了6个欧洲建筑数据集,包括OSM,微软,Overture,以及EUBUCCO,主要侧重于语义属性的可用性和完整性. 经合组织地理空间实验室提出了一个更广泛的评价框架,涵盖数据质量、可用性和治理,而其定量分析则强调建筑数量和面积,而不是目标一级的精确和回顾[10]。 最近的一个预印将GHSL、Microsoft TEMPO、GBA和Overture与跨多个光栅网的手动标注的ORBITAL-Net数据进行比较,并按区域、居住密度和国民收入组别分类结果[24]。 研究发现,根据评价标准,GBA或TEMPO的总体准确度一般最高,而非洲和亚洲的绩效则低得多,高密度城市地区的几种产品则下降。 然而,其主要目标是对建筑物面积进行网格化估计,而不是对个别建筑物的探测、匹配的足迹几何和总量协议进行联合评估。

blocks.en: Previous studies have also begun to examine whether apparent product accuracy varies systematically with settlement characteristics. Sirko et al. [20] reported separate results for urban, rural, and displaced-person settings for a single product, while Liu et al. [22] identified density-dependent bias in GHSL built-up estimates. Lahrichi et al. [24] stratified gridded building-area performance by geographic region, density, and national income group. Gevaert et al. [11] more explicitly audited four building-footprint datasets for biases associated with wealth, population density, urban–rural setting, and building size, although the analysis was restricted to two countries and vector footprint products. Collectively, these studies demonstrate that aggregate rankings can obscure important contextual variation. To our knowledge, previous comparisons have not jointly characterized how detection, geometric, and quantity accuracy vary with interpretable settlement characteristics across multiple vector and raster products.
blocks.zh: 以往的研究也开始审查产品表面准确性是否随着结算特征而有系统变化。 Sirko等 (英语). [20] 报告了针对单一产品的城市、农村和流离失所者环境的单独结果,而Liu等人则报告了这些结果。 [22] 查明了全球统一制度内置估计数中依赖密度的偏差。 Lahrichi等人[24]按地理区域、密度和国民收入类别划分了网格化建筑区的业绩。 Gevaert等人著. [11] 更明确地审计了与财富、人口密度、城乡环境和建筑规模有关的偏差的四个建筑脚印数据集,尽管分析仅限于两个国家和病媒脚印产品。 这些研究集体表明,综合排名可以掩盖重要的背景变化。 据我们所知,以往的比较没有共同说明在多种矢量和光栅产品中,检测、几何和数量精确度如何随可解释的结算特性而变化。

blocks.en: Reference data and product provenance introduce additional complications. Building benchmarks often combine reference datasets collected at different times and through different mapping processes, meaning that measured errors can reflect both candidate-product limitations and properties of the reference itself. Temporal mismatch is particularly important in rapidly growing settlements because buildings constructed after the reference imagery was acquired may appear as false positives when a newer global product is evaluated against an older reference. Product lineage can likewise compromise the independence of candidate and reference datasets. OpenBuildingMap combines OSM, Google, and Microsoft footprints [ 25 ] , while the VIDA dataset directly merges Google and Microsoft products [ 26 ] . Overture aggregates multiple upstream sources [ 13 ] , whereas GBA combines quality-guided fusion with additional PlanetScope-based extraction [ 14 ] . Such products remain highly relevant from an end-user perspective, but agreement should be interpreted cautiously where evaluated products and reference datasets share upstream sources.
blocks.zh: 参考数据和产品来源带来了更多的并发症。 构建基准往往通过不同时间和不同的绘图过程将收集的参考数据集结合起来,这意味着测量出的错误既可以反映候选产品的限制,也可以反映参考本身的属性. 在迅速增长的定居点中,时间不匹配特别重要,因为在获取参考图像后建造的建筑物,如果根据较旧的参考材料对较新的全球产品进行评价,可能看起来是虚假的阳性。 产品种类同样会损害候选人和参考数据集的独立性。 打开建筑 Map结合了OSM,Google和微软足迹[25],而VIDA数据集直接合并了Google和微软的产品[26]. Overture聚合多个上游来源[13],而GBA结合了质量导引聚与额外的PlanetScope提取[14]. 从最终用户的角度来看,这些产品仍然具有高度的相关性,但是,在经过评价的产品和参考数据集共享上游来源的情况下,应当谨慎解释协议。

blocks.en: Overall, previous research demonstrates that estimates of building-dataset accuracy depend on the geographic setting, reference source, spatial scale, unit of analysis, and metric being reported. However, the literature remains fragmented across different dimensions of accuracy: some studies emphasize detection, others geometric overlap, raster classification agreement, building quantities, or contextual bias. Few evaluate these dimensions jointly under a common protocol, and fewer still investigate how apparent product performance changes with settlement characteristics, reference provenance, or temporal alignment. This study extends the existing literature by comparing seven current vector and raster products within a harmonized benchmark, evaluating complementary detection, geometric, and quantity properties, and combining overall rankings with stratified and diagnostic analyses designed to explain when and why those rankings change.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,以前的研究表明,建筑数据集准确性的估计取决于所报告的地理环境、参考来源、空间尺度、分析单位和计量。 然而,文献在准确性的不同层面仍然支离破碎:一些研究强调检测,另一些则强调几何重叠,光栅分类协议,建筑数量,或背景偏差. 很少有人根据共同协议共同评估这些方面,较少人仍然调查明显产品性能如何随着结算特征、参考来源或时间调整而变化。 这项研究扩展了现有文献,在统一基准范围内比较了7种现有矢量和光栅产品,评价了辅助检测、几何和数量特性,并将总体排名与分级和诊断分析相结合,旨在解释这些排名何时和为何发生变化。

blocks.en: Overture Maps is an open global vector dataset distributed in GeoParquet format with building and building_part feature types. It combines community-contributed data, primarily OpenStreetMap, with machine-learning-derived footprints and is updated through recurring public releases [ 27 , 13 ] . Updates are released monthly, but the date of the underlying data is unknown.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Workflow for evaluating vector building-footprint products against reference polygons. Candidate and reference footprints are reprojected to a local projected coordinate reference system, repaired for invalid geometries, filtered to remove polygons smaller than 20 m², and divided into fixed 1 km × 1 km tiles. Aggregate quantity metrics are computed directly from the candidate and reference building inventories. Within each tile, candidate and reference buildings are matched one-to-one using intersection over union (IoU), with a threshold of 0.50 for all reference datasets except SpaceNet 7, for which 0.25 is used. Matched pairs define true positives, unmatched candidate polygons define false positives, and unmatched reference polygons define false negatives; these are used to compute precision, recall, and F1 score. Matched pairs are further assessed using relative area error, matched IoU, and boundary F-score with a 2 m positional tolerance.
blocks.zh: 图2:对照参考多边形评估矢量建筑脚印产品的工作流程。 候选人和参考脚印被重新投射到一个局部的预测坐标参考系统,为无效的几何美图修复,过滤去除小于20 m2的多边形,并分为固定的1 km×1 km的瓦片. 总量指标直接从候选人和参考建筑清单中计算。 每块瓷砖内,选用楼和参考楼采用交联(IoU)上方的一对一配对,除SpaceNet 7外,所有参考数据集的阈值为0.50,使用0.25. 配对对定义真阳性,无配对候选多边形定义假阳性,无配对参考多边形定义假阴性;这些用于计算精度,召回,和F1分数. 对匹配的对子使用相对的区域误差进行进一步评估,匹配IoU,边界F分数则使用2米位置耐受度.

blocks.en: The validation framework used in this study built on three design choices. First, products are assessed within their own representation: vector products through object-based matching, raster products through grid-based comparison, harmonized only at defined points of comparison. Second, metric families are selected to answer the distinct operational questions set out in Section 1 : whether a product finds the buildings that exist (Sections 4.2.1 and 4.3 ), whether the mapped footprints are reliable and whether they tend to overestimate or underestimate the built-up area in cities (Sections 4.2.2 and 4.3 ). Third, performance is reported not only in aggregate but stratified by interpretable settlement characteristics, complemented by diagnostic analyses of specific error sources (Section 4.5 ). Vector products are evaluated through object-based detection and geometric agreement, while raster products are evaluated through grid-based comparisons of built-up presence and area. Candidate rasters are binarized at their native resolution before aggregation to a common evaluation grid, preserving product-specific information while enabling consistent comparison.
blocks.zh: 本研究采用的验证框架基于三个设计选择. 首先,产品在自己的表述范围内进行评估:矢量产品通过基于对象的匹配,光栅产品通过基于网格的比较,仅在确定的比较点统一. 第二,选择衡量家庭来回答第1节提出的不同业务问题:产品是否找到现存的建筑物(第4.2.1和4.3节),所绘制的足迹是否可靠,它们是否倾向于高估或低估城市的建筑面积(第4.2.2和4.3节)。 第三,业绩报告不仅汇总,而且按可解释的结算特征分级,辅之以对具体错误源的诊断分析(第4.5节)。 矢量产品通过基于物体的检测和几何协议来评价,而光栅产品则通过基于网格的构建存在和面积比较来评价. 候选光栅在聚合到一个共同评价网格之前按其原生分辨率进行二进制,保留特定产品的信息,同时能够进行一致的比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 Preprocessing and Spatial Tiling
blocks.zh: 4.1 预处理和空间铺设

This local projected CRS was used for all clipping, tiling, and area/distance calculations, ensuring metric accuracy regardless of the city’s location. Final outputs were stored in geographic coordinates (WGS 84, EPSG:4326). Invalid geometries are repaired, and polygons smaller than τ size = 20 ​ m 2 \tau_{\text{size}}=20\text{m}^{2} are removed to reduce slivers and digitization artefacts. For vector boundary comparisons, a positional tolerance τ misalign = 2 ​ m \tau_{\text{misalign}}=2m accounts for small offsets caused by differences in image acquisition, georeferencing, or digitization. All matching and metric computation, including density- and size-stratified breakdowns, are performed within fixed 1 ​ km × 1 ​ km 1\text{km}\times 1\text{km} tiles, the pipeline’s common spatial unit, supporting scalable, consistent cross-city aggregation. Each reference building is assigned to the tile containing its centroid when computing counts, density, and mean size, so buildings spanning multiple tiles are counted once.

blocks.en: 4.2 Vector Building-Footprint Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 病媒建筑物-福特印刷品评价

blocks.en: Vector products are evaluated by matching candidate polygons to reference buildings and measuring both detection and geometric accuracy (Figure 2 ). We report F1, IoU, and relative area error (RAE) as complementary measures of segmentation quality. F1 captures object-level detection accuracy, IoU provides a stricter, geometry-sensitive measure of segmentation quality, penalizing boundary errors and shape irregularity that F1 can overlook. Yet IoU can still mask systematic size bias: a model that consistently over- or under-estimates footprint area may retain a moderate IoU. We report relative area error (RAE), the normalized difference between predicted and ground-truth footprint area, to directly test model reliability for area-dependent indicators.

blocks.en: Raster products represent built-up presence, fraction, density, or height rather than discrete buildings. They are therefore evaluated using a harmonized grid-based framework (Figure 3 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Workflow for evaluating raster building and settlement products against reference building footprints. Reference polygons are rasterized to fractional built-up coverage at the target evaluation-grid resolution and binarized using a 20 m² built-up-area threshold. Candidate raster products are binarized at their native resolution using product-specific thresholds, then aggregated to a common evaluation grid and reclassified using the same 20 m² threshold. We evaluate at 10 m for OBT and WSF Tracker and at 100 m for all raster products, within fixed 1 km × 1 km spatial tiles. blocks.zh: 图3:对照参考建筑足迹评估光栅建筑和定居点产品的工作流程。 参考多边形在目标评价网格分辨率上被光栅化成分数积聚覆盖,并使用20平方米积聚区阈值进行二进制. 候选光栅产品按其原生分辨率采用产品特定阈值进行二进制,然后汇总为共同评价网格,并使用相同的20平方米阈值重新分类. 我们在固定的1公里×1公里空间瓦片范围内,对OBT和WSF跟踪器进行10米评价,对所有光栅产品进行100米评价。 我们使用基于网格的精度、召回和F1分数以及相对的区域误差、数量和分配分歧来评估业绩。

blocks.en: The raster workflow consists of three stages:
blocks.zh: 光栅工作流程包括三个阶段:

blocks.en: 1. Reference rasterization. Reference polygons are rasterized to fractional built-up coverage at each evaluation-grid resolution, then binarized using a fixed reference threshold: a cell is classified as built-up when its covered area is at least 20 ​ m 2 20\text{m}^{2} . This reference threshold is identical at the 10m and 100m grids and is held fixed across all candidate comparisons. 2. Native-resolution classification. Each candidate product is first binarized at its own native resolution, using a minimum-detectable-building-area specific to that product ( 4 ​ m 2 4\text{m}^{2} , translating to a  0.25 threshold for OBT; 20 ​ m 2 20\text{m}^{2} , translating to a  0.20 threshold for WSF Tracker, TEMPO, and GHSL), converted to a fractional threshold by dividing by the product’s native pixel area. Categorical products, such as WSF Tracker, are instead classified directly from the codes representing settlement or built-up land, bypassing the area threshold. 3. Common-grid aggregation. The native binary masks from the previous step are block-averaged to the common evaluation grid and re-thresholded using the same global 20 ​ m 2 20\text{m}^{2} reference threshold used for the reference layer (step 1); not the candidate’s own native-resolution threshold. This ensures every candidate is evaluated against an identical definition of built-up once results are compared at a common resolution, isolating differences in detection capability (step 2) from differences in the comparison threshold. Two evaluation grids are used. WSF Tracker (native 10m, Sentinel-1/2-derived) and OBT (native 4m) are aggregated to a 10m grid, the finer of the two supported resolutions; both are also aggregated to a 100m grid. TEMPO and GHSL, natively 100m, are evaluated only at 100m — a native-resolution guard excludes them from the 10m grid, since disaggregating below native support would not be meaningful.

blocks.en: In addition to understanding the overall performance of the datasets, metrics are additionally reported in stratified form. blocks.en: Next to the stratified evaluation, two diagnostic experiments were conducted. The first considers very small buildings in particular. Visual inspection of the global vector datasets suggested that there were disproportionate errors for very small buildings. The first diagnostic experiment therefore specifically looked at the smallest buildings. The vector matching was re-run as a separate experiment using the same matcher, the same per-city IoU thresholds, and the same 20 m 2 minimum-area filter, retaining the area of every building classified as a true positive, false positive, or false negative. Buildings were assigned to six fixed size classes (20–40, 40–60, 60–80, 80–120, 120–180 and > > 180 m 2 ), and within each class the share of candidate buildings that are false positives and the share of reference buildings that are missed were computed per product. The percentage of FP or TP which fell into the smallest building size bin is used to assess the validity of this observation.
blocks.zh: 在分级评估之后,进行了两次诊断实验。 第一种观点尤其认为建筑物很小。 对全球矢量数据集的目视检查表明,非常小的建筑物有不成比例的错误。 因此,第一个诊断实验专门研究了最小的建筑物。 矢量匹配被重新运行为单独的实验,使用相同的匹配器,相同的每个城市IoU阈值,以及相同的20米2最小区域滤波器,保留每个建筑被归类为真实正,假正,或假负的面积. 建筑物被分配到六个固定规模的类别(20-40、40-60、60-80、80-120、120-180和 > 180米2),每个类别中,有误的候选建筑物的份额和错失的参考建筑物的份额按产品计算。 将FP或TP中跌入最小的建筑尺寸桶的百分比用于评估这一观察的有效性。

blocks.en: The second diagnostic experiment assesses the temporal alignment. Reference footprints and candidate products are not acquired simultaneously, so a portion of the errors reflect genuine construction or demolition of buildings. The magnitude of this contribution was estimated using the sub-annual WSFTracker time series, which is the only evaluated product with a temporal resolution finer than one year and available for the time span of the datasets. For each study area, the evaluation was repeated using the WSF Tracker time step closest to the acquisition date of that area’s reference imagery, rather than the most recent time step, and the difference in city-level F 1 F_{1} between the aligned and baseline evaluations was recorded.
blocks.zh: 第二次诊断实验评估了时间吻合. 参考脚印和候选产品不是同时获得的,因此部分错误反映了建筑物的真正建造或拆除. 利用WSFTracker分年度时间序列估计了这种贡献的规模,这是唯一经过评估的、时间分辨率比一年更细且在数据集的时间内可以得到的产品。 在每个研究领域,利用最接近该地区参考图象获取日期的WSF跟踪器时间步骤,而不是最新的时间步骤,重复了评价,并记录了对齐评价与基线评价在城市一级F 1 F_{1}之间的差异。

blocks.zh: 5.1 总体产品绩效

blocks.en: Overture Maps achieved the strongest overall vector performance across the benchmark (Figure 4 ). Its median city-level precision, recall, and F1 were 0.720, 0.926, and 0.786, respectively. The Global Building Atlas (GBA) followed with a median precision of 0.533, recall of 0.721, and F1 of 0.564, while 3D-GloBFP achieved corresponding values of 0.462, 0.449, and 0.458. Overture was the highest scoring vector product in 58% of the study areas for which all three products were available.
blocks.zh: Overture Maps实现了整个基准最强的总矢量性能(图4 )。 它的市级中位精度,召回,F1分别为0.720,0.926和0.786. Global Building Atlas(GBA)紧随其后的中位精度为0.533,召回0.721,F1为0.564,而3D-GloBFP则实现了相应的0.462,0.449和0.458. 在58%的研究领域,所有三种产品都有使用,而重叠是最高的矢量产品。

blocks.en: The benefit of selecting a different vector product for each city was small. Choosing the highest-performing product city by city increased median F1 by only 0.004 relative to using Overture throughout. Moreover, in the 32 study areas where Overture scored below 0.5, neither GBA nor 3D-GloBFP achieved an F1 above 0.6. This co-occurrence of poor performance indicates that difficult locations were generally challenging for all three products rather than being resolved by switching datasets.
blocks.zh: 为每个城市选择不同的病媒产品的好处很小。 按城市选择业绩最高的产品城市,与整个使用Overture相比,F1的中位数只增加了0.04。 此外,在Overture得分低于0.5的32个研究领域,无论是GBA还是3D-GloBFP都没有达到0.6以上的F1. 业绩不佳的共同情况表明,对于所有三种产品而言,困难地点一般都具有挑战性,而不是通过交换数据集来解决。

blocks.en: Matched-footprint geometry showed the same ordering. Overture achieved a median matched-pair IoU of 0.965 and boundary F-score of 0.974, compared with 0.625 and 0.712 for GBA and 0.582 and 0.609 for 3D-GloBFP. The near-perfect geometric agreement for Overture should nevertheless be interpreted cautiously where the reference data and candidate product share OpenStreetMap provenance.
blocks.zh: 匹配的脚印几何显示相同的顺序. Overture实现了0.965和0.974的中位配角IoU,而GBA的边界F分数分别为0.625和0.712,3D-GloBFP为0.582和0.609。 然而,如果参考数据和候选产品共享OpenStreetMap的出处,对Overture近乎完美的几何协议应当谨慎地加以解释。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Raster Settlement Products
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 拉斯特定居产品

blocks.en: Raster rankings depended on the evaluation-grid resolution (Figure 5 ). At 10 m, Google Open Buildings Temporal 2.5D (OBT) achieved a median precision of 0.568, recall of 0.878, and F1 of 0.642, exceeding WSF Tracker, whose median precision, recall, and F1 were 0.485, 0.796, and 0.517. OBT achieved the highest 10 m F1 in 67 common study areas, compared with three for WSF Tracker. At 100 m, WSF Tracker ranked first with a median precision of 0.888, recall of 0.974, and F1 of 0.862. It was followed by TEMPO (0.768), GHSL (0.752), and OBT (0.718). Among 70 study areas with complete coverage for all four raster products, WSF Tracker achieved the highest 100m F1 in 76% of the areas, compared with 14% for GHSL, 6% for TEMPO, and 4% for OBT.
blocks.zh: 拉斯特的排名取决于评价网分辨率(图5). 10米时,Google Open Buildings Temperal 2.5D(OBT)的中位精度达到0.568,召回0.878,F1为0.642,超过了WSF Tracker的中位精度,召回,F1为0.485,0.796,0.517. OBT在67个共同研究领域实现了最高的10 m F1,而WSF Tracker则达到了3个. 在100米时,WSF Tracker以中位精度0.888位列第一,召回0.974位,F1位0.862. 随后是TEMPO(0.768)、GHSL(0.752)和OBT(0.718)。 在全部四个光栅产品覆盖的70个研究领域中,WSF Tracker在76%的地区实现了最高的100m F1,而GHSL为14%,TEMPO为6%,OBT为4%。

blocks.en: The 10 m and 100 m results represent different evaluation tasks and should not be interpreted as directly comparable measures of fine-scale accuracy. Aggregation to 100 m absorbs small positional and delineation errors and rewards agreement in broader settlement extent. At 10 m, additional settlement components represented by WSF Tracker, such as lots and internal roads, are more frequently counted as false-positive pixels relative to building-footprint references.
blocks.zh: 10米和100米的成果代表着不同的评价任务,不应被解释为可直接比较的精细尺度精确度测量。 聚合到100米可吸收更广泛的定居范围内的小位置和划界错误和奖励协议。 在10米处,以WSF Tracker为代表的其他定居点部分,如批量和内部道路,相对于建筑物脚印参考物,更经常被算作假阳性像素.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Distribution of city-level mean tile F1 scores for raster products evaluated at 10 m and 100 m. Boxes show the interquartile range and grey points represent individual study areas. Results at the two grid resolutions describe evaluation tasks of different spatial granularity.
blocks.zh: 图5:城市一级对10米和100米评价的光栅产品的平均瓦片F1分数分布情况。 方框显示方位范围,灰色点代表个别研究区域。 两个网格分辨率的结果描述了不同空间颗粒度的评价任务.

blocks.en: 5.2 Geometric and Quantity Agreement
blocks.zh: 5.2 几何和数量协议

blocks.en: Detection scores quantify spatial correspondence but do not establish whether a product reproduces the correct total building area or number of structures. We therefore evaluated vector area and count agreement and raster built-up-area error separately.
blocks.zh: 检测分数量化空间对应,但不确定某一产品是否复制了正确的总建筑面积或结构数量. 因此,我们分别评估了矢量区和计数协议以及光栅建成区错误。

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Vector Area and Building Counts
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 矢量区和建筑物计数

blocks.en: Overture and GBA modestly overestimated aggregate building quantities (Figure 6 ). Overture had a median total area bias of 0.093 and a candidate-to-reference count ratio of 1.155, corresponding to 9.3% more mapped building area and 15.5% more building polygons than in the references. GBA showed similar positive biases, with a median area bias of 0.124 and count ratio of 1.167.
blocks.zh: 重叠和GBA略微高估建筑总量(图6)。 Overture的总面积偏差中位数为0.093,候选方与参考方的计数比为1.155,相当于比参考方多绘制的建筑面积多9.3%,建筑多边形多15.5%。 GBA表现出类似的正偏差,中位区偏差为0.124,计数比为1.167.

blocks.en: Although 3D-GloBFP had the lowest object-detection F1, it was closest to aggregate quantity agreement. Its median area bias was − 0.045 -0.045 , indicating 4.5% less mapped building area, and its median count ratio of 0.905 indicated a 9.5% undercount. Thus, accurate aggregate area or count did not necessarily imply correct detection and matching of individual buildings. All products also contained substantial city-level outliers, showing that near-zero median bias did not ensure consistent local performance.
blocks.zh: 虽然3D-GloBFP的物体探测率最低,但它最接近总量协议. 其中位面积偏差为-0.045 - 0.045,表明绘图面积减少4.5%,其0.905的中位数比表明低估了9.5%。 因此,准确的总面积或计数并不一定意味着正确探测和匹配各个建筑物。 所有产品中还含有大量的城市一级外部产品,表明接近零中位偏差不能确保当地的业绩一致。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Aggregate quantity agreement for vector products. The left panel shows total area bias, where zero indicates agreement with the reference. The right panel shows candidate-to-reference building-count ratios, where one indicates exact count agreement. Labelled values are medians and grey points represent individual study areas.
blocks.zh: 图6:病媒产品总量协议。 左面板显示总面积偏差,其中零表示同意引用. 正确的小组显示候选人与参考建筑计算比率,其中显示准确的计算协议。 绑定值为中位数,灰色点代表单个研究区域.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Raster Built-Up-Area Agreement
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 建筑区协定

blocks.en: Raster products differed substantially in their estimation of total built-up area (Figure 7 ). OBT had the smallest median relative area errors at both evaluation resolutions: 0.125 at 10 m and 0.176 at 100 m. TEMPO also showed comparatively moderate overestimation, with a median relative error of 0.369, while GHSL had a median error of 0.796.
blocks.zh: 稀疏产品在总建成面积估计值上差别很大(图7)。 在两个评价分辨率中,OBT的相对误差最小:10米时为0.125,100米时为0.176。 TEMPO也显示相对中度高估,相对中位错为0.369,而GHSL的中位错为0.796.

blocks.en: WSF Tracker produced the largest positive errors, with median relative area errors of 2.146 at 10 m and 2.285 at 100 m. Its high 100 m F1 therefore reflected strong agreement in the location of settlement rather than accurate estimation of building-footprint area. Conversely, OBT had lower overlap-based scores at 100 m but reproduced total reference building area more closely. TEMPO provided the strongest balance between a relatively high F1 and moderate area overestimation.
blocks.zh: 无国界记者协会 Tracker产生最大正差,相对面积中位差为10米2.146,100米2.285. 因此,其高度为100米F1,这反映了对定居点位置的强烈一致,而不是对建筑物足迹地区的准确估计。 相反,OBT的重叠分数较低,为100米,但转录总参考建筑面积更为接近。 TEMPO提供了相对较高的F1和中度地区高估之间的最强平衡.

blocks.en: At the 100 m grid, quantity disagreement dominated for every product, accounting for 83% (WSF Tracker), 91% (GHSL), 98% (TEMPO), and 99% (OBT) of total disagreement, with median allocation disagreement below 0.016 throughout (Table 4 ). Most error therefore arose from mapping too much or too little built-up area rather than placing a comparable amount in the wrong location. At the 10 m grid, allocation disagreement rose to between roughly a quarter (OBT) and a third (WSF Tracker) of the total, reflecting positional errors that the coarser grid absorbs. This distinction indicates that product-specific multiplicative calibration could reduce aggregate quantity bias, although it would not correct local allocation errors.
blocks.zh: 在100米电网中,每种产品在数量上的分歧占主导地位,占83%(WSF Tracker),91%(GHSL),98%(TEMPO)和99%(OBT),整个分配中的分歧低于0.016(表4)。 因此,大多数错误是由于绘制过多或太少的建成区,而不是在错误的地点放置可比数额。 在10米网格上,分配上的分歧上升到大约四分之一(OBT)和三分之一(WSF Tracker)之间,这反映了粗体网格吸收的位置错误. 这种区分表明,具体产品的倍增校准可以减少总量偏差,虽然不会纠正本地分配错误.

blocks.en:
Table 4: Median per-tile quantity (QD) and allocation (AD) disagreement, and the
quantity share of total disagreement, per product and evaluation grid.
blocks.zh:
表4:每瓦中位数(QD)和分配(AD)的分歧,以及
各产品和评价网格在总分歧中所占的份额。

blocks.en: Estimated building counts inherit these area biases. Median estimated-to-reference count ratios were close to unity for TEMPO (1.09) and OBT (1.10 at 100 m, 1.11 at 10 m), moderate for GHSL (1.48), and 2.6 for WSF Tracker at both grids. Gridded products can therefore support order-of-magnitude count estimates where they delineate buildings, but require product-specific calibration where they map settlement extent. That is to say, more accurate building count estimations could be obtained through local calibration of individual products, instead of using the average building size as a conversion factor as in Eq. 6 .
blocks.zh: 估计的建筑数量继承了这些地区的偏差。 TEMPO(1.09)和OBT(100米1.10,10米1.11)的中间估计参考数比率接近统一,GHSL(1.48)的中间估计比值接近统一,WSF为2.6 两个网格的追踪器。 因此,在对建筑物进行划界时,嵌入式产品可以支持测距计数估计,但在绘制定居点范围时,则需要具体产品的校准。 也就是说,可以通过对个别产品进行局部校准,而不是像Eq. 6那样使用平均建筑面积作为换算系数,从而获得更准确的建筑计数估计。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Relative built-up-area error for the raster products. Zero indicates agreement with the reference, positive values indicate overestimation, and negative values indicate underestimation. Labelled values are medians and grey points represent individual study areas.
blocks.zh: 图7:光栅产品相对建置面积误差. 0表示与引用一致,正值表示高估,负值表示低估. 绑定值为中位数,灰色点代表单个研究区域.

blocks.en: 5.3 Stratified performance and diagnostic analyses
blocks.zh: 5.3 分级业绩和诊断分析

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Reference-Data Source
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 参考数据来源

blocks.en: Performance differed across reference-data groups (Figure 8 ). Overture achieved particularly high F1 scores against HOTOSM and other governmental or institutional references, but more moderate scores against SpaceNet  7. GBA showed a similar pattern, although its HOTOSM results were substantially more variable. 3D-GloBFP generally produced the lowest vector scores.
blocks.zh: 各参考数据组的业绩不同(图8)。 相对于HOTOSM和其他政府或机构参考文献,重叠取得了特别高的F1分,但对于SpaceNet 7.则取得了比较中度的分数. GBA显示出类似的模式,尽管其HOTOSM结果大为可变性. 3D-GloBFP一般产生最低的矢量分数.

blocks.en: Raster rankings were more stable across reference groups. WSF Tracker at 100 m achieved the highest median F1 against SpaceNet  7 (0.822), HOTOSM (0.890), and other governmental or institutional references (0.862). TEMPO and GHSL also performed strongly, particularly against HOTOSM, whereas the 10 m products generally produced lower scores.
blocks.zh: 各参考组的拉斯特排名较为稳定。 无国界记者协会 100米的跟踪器在SpaceNet 7(0.822)、HOTOSM(0.890)和其他政府或机构参考文献(0.862)中达到了F1中位数最高。 TEMPO和GHSL也表现强劲,特别是针对HOTOSM,而10米的产品一般得分较低.

blocks.en: These differences cannot be attributed solely to the reference provider, because reference source is associated with geography, acquisition date, settlement morphology, and mapping practice. This confounding was also evident in comparisons by national income group. Across the full sample, performance appeared higher in some lower-income settings because HOTOSM references were concentrated there. When the analysis was restricted to the 52 SpaceNet  7 cities with a common reference protocol, all vector products achieved median F1 scores of approximately 0.49–0.51 in low- and lower-middle-income countries, compared with approximately 0.57–0.64 in high-income countries. The resulting gap of roughly 0.13 was consistent across products but should be considered exploratory because the benchmark was not designed as a regionally representative sample.
blocks.zh: 这些差异不能仅仅归咎于参考提供者,因为参考来源与地理、获取日期、结算形态和制图做法有关。 按国民收入类别进行的比较也表明了这种混乱。 在整个抽样中,一些低收入环境中的业绩似乎较高,因为HOTOSM的参考文献集中在那里。 当分析仅限于52个具有共同参考协议的SpaceNet 7城市时,所有矢量产品在中低收入国家的F1中位数约为0.49-0.51,而在高收入国家则约为0.57-0.64。 由此产生的大约0.13的差距在产品之间是一致的,但应被视为探索性的,因为基准不是作为具有区域代表性的样本设计的。

blocks.en: Figure 8: F1 distributions by reference-data source for (a) vector and (b) raster products. Boxes show the interquartile range and grey points represent individual study areas. Boxed values in panel (b) report median F1 scores.
blocks.zh: 图8:(a)矢量和(b)光栅产品按参考数据来源分列的F1分布情况。 方框显示方位范围,灰色点代表个别研究区域。 (b) 面板中的框值报告F1中位数。

blocks.en: 5.3.2 Building Density and Size
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 建筑密度和规模

blocks.en: Settlement density was a stronger determinant of raster accuracy than building size (Figure 9 ). For all raster products, tile-level F1 increased strongly with reference building density (Spearman ρ = 0.58 \rho=0.58 – 0.75 0.75 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The relationship remained after accounting for differences among cities, with an estimated increase of approximately 0.10 in F1 per standard-deviation increase in density. Raster performance was therefore lowest and most variable for dispersed buildings, rural settlements, and peri-urban fringes, while products became increasingly difficult to distinguish in dense urban areas.
blocks.zh: 定居点密度是确定光栅准确性的一个更强有力的决定因素,而不是建筑规模(图9)。 对所有光栅产品而言,瓦片级F1随着参考建筑密度(Spearman $ = 0.58\rho = 0.58 – 0.75 0.75,p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ) 的提高而强劲增长。 关系在考虑城市之间的差异后依然存在,估计每提高密度标准F1的增幅约为0.10。 因此,在分散的建筑物、农村住区和城市边缘地区,拉斯特的性能最低,而且变化最大,而在密集的城市地区,产品越来越难以区分。

blocks.en: This pattern partly reflects the properties of grid-based evaluation. Dense settlements occupy a greater proportion of each cell, reducing the influence of small positional errors and averaging errors across many structures. In sparse areas, isolated buildings and mixed pixels have a disproportionately large effect on precision, recall, and F1.
blocks.zh: 这种模式部分反映了基于网格的评价的特性。 Dense定居点占据了每个单元格的较大比例,减少了小位置错误的影响,在许多结构中平均差错. 在稀少的地区,孤立的建筑和混合像素对精度,召回和F1. 影响特别大.

blocks.en: Vector products showed substantially weaker within-city sensitivity to density. After accounting for city-level differences, the estimated density effect was approximately 0.03 per standard deviation. Overture maintained relatively stable performance across density classes, whereas GBA and 3D-GloBFP were more variable, particularly in low-density tiles.
blocks.zh: 病媒产品在城市内部对密度的敏感性明显较低。 在计入城市层面的差异后,估计密度效应约为每标准差0.03. 重叠保持了不同密度类别之间相对稳定的性能,而GBA和3D-GloBFP则变化较大,特别是在低密度瓦片中.

blocks.en: Building size had a secondary influence. Overture was largely insensitive to mean reference-building size, while GBA and 3D-GloBFP performed less well in tiles dominated by small buildings. Among raster products, OBT and WSF Tracker at 10 m showed modest improvements for larger buildings. GHSL and TEMPO at 100 m showed no clear relationship with individual-building size, as each evaluation cell aggregated multiple structures.
blocks.zh: 建筑规模具有次要影响。 重叠基本上不敏感地表示参考建筑大小,而GBA和3D-GloBFP则在以小建筑为主的瓷砖中表现较差. 在光栅产品中,10米处的OBT和WSF Tracker对较大建筑物的改进不大。 GHSL和TEMPO在100米处没有显示与个人建筑规模的明确关系,因为每个评价单元汇总了多个结构。

blocks.zh: 5.3.3 (中文(简体) ). 较小建筑物的假正率高

blocks.en: Visual comparison of the results suggests that many of the false positives are relatively small buildings. A diagnostic experiment tested this by recovering the footprint area of every matched, spurious, and missed building, re-running the production matching (identical matcher, per-city thresholds, and 20 m² minimum-area filter). The hypothesis is confirmed for all three vector products: median FP footprint area (58–72 m 2 ) is markedly below median TP area (87–116 m 2 ), and 71–81% of candidate buildings in the 20–40 m 2 class are false positives (Table 5 , Figure 10 ).

blocks.en: 5.3.4 Temporal mismatch
blocks.zh: 5.3.4 时间不匹配

blocks.en:
Another diagnostic experiment addresses the influence of the temporal mismatch between the data used to generate the global building layers versus the date of the imagery used to generate our reference datasets. To understand the magnitude of this discrepancy, we used the WSF Tracker sub-annual time series. We re-ran the WSF Tracker evaluation metrics using the 6-month timestep that most closely matched the date of the reference data imagery. The difference between the baseline WSF Tracker accuracy and the accuracy obtained by using the closest date gives an indication of the role of the temporal mismatch on the accuracy metrics. The analysis shows that using the closest date increased the mean F1 score by +0.060 (median of +0.037), and a maximum of +0.351. Further examination of the precision versus recall cut-offs show that extending the WSF observation cutoff beyond the reference date increases recall but lowers precision and F1, as newly detected settlement is counted as a false-positive area against older reference data,
even though WSF is actually correct that a building is now there. This is as expected, as newly detected settlements are counted as false positives when compared with older reference data. This implies that the accuracies presented above could be slightly conservative, particularly for fast-growing cities.
blocks.zh:
另一项诊断实验涉及用于生成全球建筑层的数据与用于生成我们参考数据集的图像日期之间的时间不匹配的影响。 为了了解这种差异的程度,我们使用了WSF Tracker子年时序列. 我们采用最贴近参考数据图像日期的6个月时间步骤,重新确定WSF跟踪器评价指标。 基准WSF跟踪器精确度与使用最接近的日期获得的精确度之间的差异,表明了时间不匹配对准确度测量值的作用. 分析显示,使用最接近的日期,F1的平均得分增加了+0.060(中间为+0.037),最高为+0.351. 对精确度与召回截断值的进一步审查表明,将世界安全基金会的观测截断期延长到参考日期之后会提高召回率,但会降低精确度和F1,因为新发现的结算被算作与旧参考数据相比的虚假阳性区,
尽管世界安全基金会确实正确地认为,现在有一座建筑物。 与以往的参考数据相比,新发现的定居点被算作虚假阳性。 这意味着,上述情况可能略为保守,特别是对快速增长的城市而言。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Interpreting Comparative Product Performance
blocks.zh: 6.1 解释比较产品性能

blocks.en: The results show that no product is uniformly superior across data structures, metrics, and evaluation scales. Among vector datasets, Overture Maps achieved the highest detection and geometric-agreement scores. Selecting the highest-performing vector product separately for each study area improved the median F1 by only 0.004 relative to using Overture throughout, indicating limited benefit from switching products at the city scale. Moreover, locations where Overture performed poorly were generally also difficult for GBA and 3D-GloBFP. This suggests that temporal mismatch, reference quality, imagery conditions, and settlement morphology contribute substantially to common failure patterns.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,在数据结构、计量和评价尺度方面,没有任何产品具有统一的优势。 在矢量数据集中,Overture Maps实现了最高的检测和几何协议分数. 为每个研究地区分别选择性能最高的矢量产品,相对于整个使用Overture相比,F1中位数只提高了0.004,表明在城市规模上转换产品的好处有限。 此外,对于GBA和3D-GloBFP来说,Overture表现不佳的地点一般也很难。 这表明,时间不匹配、参考质量、图像条件和定居形态在很大程度上促成了常见的故障模式。

blocks.en: The raster results depend more strongly on evaluation scale and product definition. At 10 m, OBT achieved higher F1 and closer agreement with reference building area than WSF Tracker. At 100 m, WSF Tracker achieved the highest F1, but also the largest positive area bias. Its high coarse-resolution score therefore reflects agreement in broad settlement location rather than accurate delineation of building footprints.
blocks.zh: 光栅结果更依赖于评价规模和产品定义。 在10米处,OBT实现了比WSF Tracker更高的F1和更接近的参考建筑区协议. 在100米时,WSF Tracker实现了最高的F1,但也达到了最大的正区偏差. 因此,其高粗分辨率的分数反映了在广泛的定居点地点所达成的协议,而不是建筑足迹的准确划分。

blocks.en: These findings demonstrate that overlap-based accuracy and aggregate quantity agreement measure different aspects of performance. Overture achieved the strongest vector detection but modestly overestimated building area and count, whereas 3D-GloBFP produced lower F1 but aggregate quantities closer to the reference medians. Similarly, OBT reproduced total building area more closely than the other raster products despite not achieving the highest 100 m F1. A single accuracy score is therefore insufficient for product comparison.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,基于重叠的准确性和总量协议衡量业绩的不同方面。 Overture实现了最强的矢量检测,但略微高估了建筑面积和计数,而3D-GloBFP生产的F1更低,但总量更接近参考中位数. 同样,OBT复制的总建筑面积也比其他光栅产品更为接近,尽管没有达到最高的100米F1. 因此,单一准确度的分数不足以进行产品比较。

blocks.en: For raster products, quantity disagreement accounted for most disagreement at 100 m, indicating that the products generally located settlements more consistently than they estimated the amount of built-up area. Some positive bias also reflects differences in mapped concepts: reference footprints represent individual buildings, whereas settlement products may include lots, internal roads, parking areas, and mixed built surfaces. Area bias should therefore be interpreted as a combination of classification error and product definition.
blocks.zh: 就光栅产品而言,大多数分歧发生在100米处,这表明这些产品一般比估计的建成面积更一致。 一些积极的偏差也反映了地图概念的不同:参考脚印代表个别建筑物,而定居点产品可能包括地块、内部道路、停车区和混合建造的地面。 因此,地区偏差应解释为分类错误和产品定义的结合。

blocks.en: Evaluation resolution further affects apparent performance. Aggregation from 10 m to 100 m reduces sensitivity to local positional, omission, and delineation errors and consequently raises overlap-based scores. The 10 m evaluation emphasizes fine-scale delineation, whereas the 100 m evaluation emphasizes settlement extent; scores at these resolutions should not be interpreted as directly equivalent.
blocks.zh: 评价决议进一步影响到明显的绩效。 从10米到100米的聚合降低了对当地位置、疏漏和划界错误的敏感性,从而提高了基于重叠的分数。 10米评价强调细度划定,而100米评价强调定居范围;不应将这些决议的分数解释为直接相等。

blocks.en: 6.2 Variation across Geographic and Settlement Contexts
blocks.zh: 6.2 地理和住区背景的差异

blocks.en:
Performance varied substantially among study areas and reference sources. Overture and GBA achieved particularly high agreement against HOTOSM
references, partly because Overture incorporates OpenStreetMap-derived footprints and may share upstream provenance with these references. Overture remained the strongest vector product against independent sources, but its advantage there was smaller than in HOTOSM-referenced locations.
blocks.zh:
不同研究领域和参考来源的绩效差异很大。 Overture和GBA对HOTOSM达成了特别高的一致
参考文献,部分原因是 Overture包含了OpenStreetMap衍生的足迹,并可能与这些参考文献共享上游来源. 重叠仍然是对独立来源最强的矢量产品,但其优势比HOTOSM参考地点小。

blocks.en: Reference-source comparisons are also confounded with geography, acquisition date, settlement form, and annotation protocol. Apparent regional or income-group differences should therefore be interpreted cautiously, particularly because the reference sample was not designed to be globally representative.
blocks.zh: 参考源比较也与地理,购置日期,结算表,注释协议相混淆. 因此,应当谨慎地解释明显的区域或收入群体差异,特别是因为参考样本并非具有全球代表性。

blocks.en: Settlement density was more influential than building size, especially for raster products. Raster F1 increased strongly with density and was lowest and most variable in sparse rural and peri-urban areas. In dense settlements, buildings occupy more of each cell, positional errors have less influence, and errors are averaged across many structures. As a result, products become increasingly difficult to distinguish in dense urban areas.
blocks.zh: 定居点密度比建筑规模更有影响力,特别是对光栅产品而言。 Raster F1随着密度的增加而强劲增长,在稀少的农村和近郊地区最低且变化最大。 在密集的定居点中,建筑物占据了每个牢房中较多的部分,位置错误的影响较小,许多建筑的平均错误. 因此,在密集的城市地区,产品越来越难以区分。

blocks.en: Vector products were less sensitive to within-city density. Overture remained comparatively stable across density and size classes, whereas GBA and 3D-GloBFP performed less consistently in tiles dominated by small or dispersed buildings. Building size had only a secondary effect: the 10 m raster products improved modestly for larger buildings, while the 100 m products showed little relationship with individual-building size because each cell aggregated multiple structures.
blocks.zh: 病媒产品对城市内部密度的敏感度较低。 不同密度和体积等级的重叠情况相对稳定,而GBA和3D-GloBFP在以小建筑或分散建筑为主的瓷砖中的表现则不太一致。 建筑尺寸只产生副作用:10米光栅产品对更大的建筑来说略有改善,而100米的建筑尺寸与个人建筑尺寸几乎没有关系,因为每个细胞都聚合了多个结构.

blocks.en: 6.3 Implications for future evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.3 对今后评价的影响

blocks.en: The principal contribution of this study is a common benchmark for comparing three vector and four raster products using multiple reference sources and complementary detection, geometry, area, and count metrics. Three design choices of our validation scheme are transferable to future evaluations. First, vector and raster products are first assessed within their own representation. Second, the validation scheme makes use of complementary types of evaluation metrics which are clearly linked to different operational questions and intended uses. The results show why this matters as the datasets with the strongest detection performance (macro F1) is not always the product with the most accurate aggregate building area (relative area error). Third, the validation framework disaggregates evaluation metrics to help understand which specific areas of a city might be expected to have higher or lower performance. The additional temporal alignment diagnostic shows how much of the dataset error is due to genuine settlement change. Because global building datasets are updated frequently, the value of the study extends beyond the present rankings. The pre-processing, matching, rasterization, tiling, and evaluation procedures provide a reproducible framework for testing future releases and newly developed products.
blocks.zh: 本研究的主要贡献是用多种参考来源和互补检测、几何、面积和计数度量比较三个矢量和四个光栅产品的共同基准。 我们验证计划的三个设计选择可转用于今后的评价。 首先,病媒和光栅产品首先在它们自己的代表范围内进行评估。 第二,鉴定计划利用与不同业务问题和预期用途有明确联系的辅助性评价衡量标准。 结果显示,作为检测性能最强的数据集(macro F1),这之所以重要,并不总是具有最准确的聚合建筑面积(相对区域误差)的产品. 第三,验证框架对评价衡量标准进行了分类,以帮助了解城市哪些具体领域的业绩可能较高或较低。 额外的时间对齐诊断显示,数据集误差有多少是由于真正的结算变化所致. 由于全球建筑数据集经常更新,研究的价值超越了目前的排名. 预处理、配对、光栅化、平板化和评价程序为测试未来释放和新开发的产品提供了一个可复制的框架。

blocks.en: Current global datasets provide broad coverage and consistent processing, but they cannot be expected to match the accuracy of locally produced datasets derived from high-resolution satellite, aerial, or drone imagery. Where finer spatial accuracy is required, locally trained mapping pipelines may provide better results by trading global consistency for regional precision. The same validation framework can be used to compare such local products with existing global datasets.
blocks.zh: 目前的全球数据集提供广泛的覆盖面和一致的处理,但不能指望它们与从高分辨率卫星、空中或无人驾驶飞机图像中得出的当地生产的数据集的准确性相匹配。 在需要更精细的空间精确度时,经过当地培训的绘图管道可以通过以全球一致性换取区域精确度来提供更好的结果。 同样的验证框架可用于将这种本地产品与现有的全球数据集进行比较。

blocks.en: Future evaluations should report complementary object-, grid-, and area-based metrics rather than a single headline score. They should also document reference provenance, temporal alignment, evaluation resolution, and the physical feature represented by each product.
blocks.zh: 今后的评价应报告互补的基于对象、网格和地区的衡量标准,而不是单一的标题评分。 它们还应记录参考来源、时间调整、评价分辨率以及每种产品所代表的物理特征。

blocks.en: 6.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.4 限制

blocks.en: Four limitations qualify the results. First, candidate products and reference datasets were not acquired at identical times. Product epochs span approximately 2015–2025, while reference dates vary among study areas. Construction, demolition, and redevelopment between dates may therefore appear as omission or commission errors (quantified for WSF Tracker in section 5.3.4 ), particularly in rapidly urbanising locations. The reported accuracy values may consequently represent conservative estimates of dataset agreement.
blocks.zh: 4种限制使结果符合条件。 首先,没有在同一时间获得候选产品和参考数据集。 产品时代跨度约为2015-2025年,而参考日期因研究领域而异。 因此,在日期之间的建造、拆除和重新开发可能被视为省略或佣金错误(第5.3.4节中WSF Tracker的量化),特别是在迅速城市化的地点。 因此,所报告的准确性值可能是对数据集协议的保守估计。

blocks.en: Second, the references are not fully independent of all products. Overture incorporates OpenStreetMap footprints, while HOTOSM references are also OSM-derived. Shared provenance may inflate agreement in these study areas, although Overture remained the strongest vector product against independent references.
blocks.zh: 第二,参考文献并非完全独立于所有产品。 Overture 包含 OpenStreetMap 脚印,而 HOTOSM 引用也是OSM 衍生的. 共同来源可能会增加这些研究领域的一致意见,尽管与独立参考相比,Overture仍然是最强的矢量产品。

blocks.en: Third, SpaceNet 7 buildings were matched using an IoU threshold of 0.25, following the challenge protocol [ 34 ] , whereas a threshold of 0.50 was used for other reference sources. The pooled statistics therefore combine two matching protocols, and SpaceNet 7 results should be interpreted with this distinction in mind.
blocks.zh: 第三,SpaceNet 7的建筑采用IoU阈值0.25,遵循质疑协议[34],而其他参考来源则采用0.50的阈值。 因此,集合统计数据结合了两个匹配协议,应当铭记这一区别来解释SpaceNet 7的结果。

blocks.en: Fourth, the findings apply to the evaluation scales used in the study. Accuracy was calculated within 1 ​ km × 1 ​ km 1\,\text{km}\times 1\,\text{km} tiles and summarized at approximately city or municipality scale. The results support comparisons at these aggregate scales but do not certify individual building polygons. They should not be used without independent verification for cadastral registration, property-boundary determination, compensation, demolition, or other building-level decisions. City-level averages may also conceal weaker performance in sparse peripheral settlements.
blocks.zh: 第四,调查结果适用于研究中使用的评价尺度。 精确度计算在 1 km × 1 km 1\,\ text{ km} times 1\,\ text{ km} 瓦片以大约城市或市镇规模进行归纳 。 这些结果支持在这些总体尺度上进行比较,但不证明单个建筑多边形。 未经对地籍登记、财产边界确定、赔偿、拆除或其他建筑一级决定进行独立核查,不得使用这些资产。 城市一级的平均数可能也掩盖了人口稀少的外围住区业绩较弱。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This study shows that no global building dataset is uniformly superior across representations, metrics, and settlement conditions. This conclusion is itself a consequence of how the validation scheme was designed: by pairing complementary evaluation metrics matched to distinct operational questions, and with stratification by settlement characteristics and diagnostic experiments on specific error sources, the results presented here identify the conditions under which each product has a stronger or weaker performance rather than producing a single ranking. Among vector products, Overture Maps provided the strongest overall building-detection performance, with a median city-level F1 of 0.786. Selecting the highest-performing vector product separately for each city improved median F1 by only 0.004 relative to always using Overture, supporting its use as a strong general baseline where reliable local data are unavailable. Performance approached 1.0 in some locations represented by extensive OpenStreetMap digitization, but varied substantially elsewhere. Overture also modestly overestimated aggregate building area and count by approximately 9% and 16%, respectively, predominantly through the inclusion of additional small structures. In contrast, 3D-GloBFP had lower detection performance but more balanced aggregate area and building counts.
blocks.zh: 这项研究显示,没有一个全球建筑数据集在表述、计量和结算条件方面都具有统一优势。 这一结论本身就是验证计划如何设计的产物:将补充性评价指标与不同的业务问题相匹配,并按结算特征进行分层,对具体错误源进行诊断试验,在此提出的结果确定了每种产品具有较强或较弱性能的条件,而不是产生单一的排名。 在矢量产品中,Overture Maps提供了最强的整体建筑探测性能,城市一级F1中位数为0.786. 为每个城市分别选择最高性能的矢量产品,相对于总是使用Overture相比,改进了F1中位数仅0.04,支持在没有可靠当地数据的情况下将其作为强有力的一般基准。 在一些以广泛OpenStreetMap数字化为代表的地点,业绩接近1.0,但在其他地方则大不相同。 此外,还略微高估了总建筑面积,并分别估计了大约9%和16%,主要通过增加小型建筑。 相比之下,3D-GloBFP的探测性能较低,但总面积和建筑计数更为平衡。

blocks.en: For raster products, performance depended strongly on both product and evaluation resolution. At 10 m, Google Open Buildings Temporal 2.5D achieved a higher median F1 than WSF Tracker (0.642 versus 0.517) and produced the smallest built-up-area error. Its use is nevertheless limited by geographic coverage and a latest observation year of 2023. WSF Tracker provides broader global and sub-annual coverage and, when evaluated at 100 m, achieved the highest median F1 of 0.862. However, unlike OBT, the WSF Tracker raster captures additional built-up areas such as parking lots and narrow roads, which causes it to substantially overestimate the total building area. This emphasizes that raster products should therefore not be used to infer building counts without local calibration, because they may include roads, parking areas, and other non-building impervious surfaces.
blocks.zh: 就光栅产品而言,性能在很大程度上取决于产品和评价分辨率。 在10米时,Google Open Building Temperal 2.5D实现了比WSF Tracker更高的中位数F1(0.642对0.517),并产生了最小的建成区误差. 然而,其使用受到地理覆盖范围和2023年最新观测年的限制。 无国界记者协会 Tracker提供更广泛的全球和分年度覆盖面,在100米评价时达到最高中位数F1,为0.862. 然而,与OBT不同的是,WSF Tracker光栅捕捉到更多的建筑区,如停车场和狭窄的道路,这导致它大大高估了总建筑面积. 这强调光栅产品因此不应被用来在没有局部校准的情况下推断建筑计数,因为它们可能包括道路,停车区,以及其他非建筑的不透水面.

blocks.en: Settlement context further affected performance. Raster F1 increased strongly with building density and was least reliable in sparsely developed areas. The 10 m products also performed somewhat better where buildings were larger, whereas vector products were less sensitive to these conditions, particularly Overture Maps. Coarser 100 m evaluation generally produced higher F1 because spatial aggregation reduces sensitivity to local positional and omission errors; these scores should not be interpreted as evidence of better fine-scale building delineation.
blocks.zh: 定居环境进一步影响了业绩。 拉斯特F1随着建筑密度的提高而强劲增长,在欠发达地区最不可靠. 在建筑物较大的地方,10米的产品表现也有些好,而病媒产品对这些条件,特别是Overture Maps,不太敏感。 Coarser 100 m的评价一般产生更高的F1,因为空间聚合降低了对局部位置和省略错误的敏感性;这些分数不应被解释为更好的细尺度建筑划定的证据.

blocks.en: Where authoritative local building footprints are unavailable, global products provide useful alternatives, but their uncertainty, spatial resolution, area bias, and geographic variation must be considered explicitly. Applications requiring parcel-level reliability or detailed building geometry may still require locally validated mapping based on high-resolution satellite, aerial, or drone imagery.

blocks.en: Raster harmonisation and binarisation
blocks.zh: 光栅协调和二进制

blocks.en:
Raster products were evaluated using a three-stage procedure:
(1) rasterisation of the vector reference data,
(2) binarisation of each candidate product at its native resolution, and
(3) area-weighted aggregation to the common evaluation grid.
This procedure preserves each product’s native spatial support while ensuring that all datasets are compared using the same definition of built-up area at the evaluation resolution.

采用三阶段程序对Raster产品进行了评价:

(2) 将每种候选产品在原生溶液中二进制,以及
(3)区域加权汇总到共同评价网格.
这一程序保留了每种产品的本土空间支持,同时确保所有数据集在评价分辨率上使用相同的构建区域定义进行比较。
